source.title: Behavioural and neural sequelae of stressor exposure are not modulated by controllability in females

confidence_rationale: Strong support for MECH-340's core architectural commitment that persistence is an EXPLICIT, SEPARABLE control/efficacy gate over a disengagement default -- not a property of the stressor or of accumulated failure. In males, behavioural control over an identical stressor abolishes its sequelae via a prelimbic->dorsal-raphe gate; in females the same control is acquired but does NOT engage that protective circuit, so the buffering is absent -- and pharmacological activation of prelimbic cortex restores it. A dissociation in which identical control with identical outcomes does or does not gate persistence depending on whether a specific cortical circuit is engaged is exactly the 'the gate is a separate mechanism, present-but-can-be-silent' structure MECH-340 posits. Held at 0.62: rodent stressor-controllability paradigm mapped to an agent's goal-bank persistence is a structural analogy with real transfer risk, and the female-circuit finding is a boundary as much as a confirmation.
failure_signatures: A persistence gate can be PRESENT yet not ENGAGED: females acquire the controlling response and possess the prelimbic->DRN circuitry, yet the protective gate is not recruited and the disengagement default proceeds -- so 'the gate exists' does not entail 'the gate fires', and an architecture that conflates the two mispredicts the female data.

Persistence buffering tracks engagement of a specific cortical control-detection circuit, not the objective controllability of the situation: identical control with successful acquisition produces opposite sequelae depending on circuit engagement, ruling out a gate keyed on attained-control-as-fact rather than detected-control-as-signal.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Behavioural control over a stressor normally eliminates its neurochemical and behavioural sequelae through a prelimbic-cortex circuit that projects to and inhibits the dorsal raphe nucleus. In female rats this protective effect of control is absent: animals acquire the controlling response, and the prelimbic->DRN circuitry is present, but behavioural control fails to selectively engage the prelimbic cells that project to the dorsal raphe. Pharmacological activation of the prelimbic cortex restores the stress-buffering effect of control.
mapping.ree_translation: Direct support for MECH-340's gate as an explicit, separable mechanism layered over a disengagement default. MECH-340 says a control/efficacy-detection signal MAINTAINS an unresolved-goal bank entry as an active MECH-293 re-probe target, and its ABSENCE is the default (the entry decays in MECH-292 rank without erasing the SD-039 trace). Baratta et al. show that the control-detection gate (prelimbic->DRN) is dissociable from the fact of control: it can be present-but-unengaged, in which case the default sequelae proceed; and it can be switched on pharmacologically. This is the strongest available evidence that 'gate persistence / default disengage' is implemented as a distinct, recruitable circuit -- exactly the explicit/separable property MECH-340's evidence note requires (Koster/Gillan).
mapping.mapping_caveat: Aversive stressor-controllability paradigm in rats, indexing helplessness-type behaviour (escape failure, social exploration) and dorsal-raphe serotonergic activation -- not an agent re-probing a stored goal. The mapping imports the CIRCUIT LOGIC (separable control-detection gate over a default), not the behaviour. The female finding is a sex-specific engagement boundary whose REE analogue is unspecified; it is used here as evidence that gate-presence != gate-engagement, not as a claim about sex.
mapping.source_context: Rat behavioural neuroscience: escapable vs yoked-inescapable tailshock, juvenile social exploration / shuttle-box escape / fear assays, dorsal-raphe 5-HT and prelimbic->DRN tract-tracing + c-fos, plus prelimbic pharmacological activation.

confidence_components.notes: Rigorous circuit-level dissociation with a causal pharmacological restoration (high source quality). Mapping fidelity moderate-to-high for the SEPARABILITY claim (the gate is a distinct, recruitable circuit, present-but-silent in females) which is the precise property MECH-340 needs beyond Maier & Seligman 2016's default-inversion. Transfer risk moderate: rodent aversive controllability -> agent goal-bank persistence is a structural analogy.
